title: Improving the integer multiplication bound
question: Can we improve the bound in OpenAI's Integer multiplication below n log n?
summary: OpenAI's paper gives an integer multiplication algorithm with running time O(n (log n)^(1−κ)) for κ = 2⁻¹⁸² on a fixed multitape Turing machine. Can we obtain a better asymptotic bound in the same model? The CrocSwap project provides constructions and certificates for conditional improvements, offering a starting point for further work.
